about.title: A day in Savva

body.text: Savva is a specialty coffee house in Madinah. The room is quiet by design: soft light, a recently refreshed interior, and a terrace for the cooler hours. The coffee of the day moves between Ethiopian and Colombian beans, and the cheesecake rarely lasts the afternoon. Doors open early and close at two.

about.quote: A day in savva is what you need to be savva
